name: Calm Harbor
purpose: CentralHub merged variant: even-keel design (structure/type/motion/grid) + ink-charter color palette, per user grading feedback

motion-system.twistDescription: Duration scaling (slower) x1.3 — all transition/animation durations lengthened for a calmer, more deliberate enterprise cadence; no color or easing changes.

color-system.twistDescription: ink-charter palette adopted wholesale: white ground, navy ink #1b1b37, teal #63cabe primary accent, violet #b79cff / blue #477cbe secondary

nav-system.twistDescription: Nav height adjustment (twist A): the absolute overlay nav gains a defined 32px enterprise bar height, clamped to the 32-96px range.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A (hover transition speed, more languid, intensity 3): added +0.15s to every hover/state transition duration — timing only, no color or structural changes, evoking the slow settle of an analog gauge needle.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Global spacing scale factor x1.35 (twist A) for generous, systematic enterprise breathing room; var/calc/unset/0 and pill radius left intact.

grid-system.twistDescription: Container max-width tightened 1800px -> 1600px (~11%) for a tighter, more editorial B2B SaaS grid; no color changes.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted the Material Presence paragraph from a lush, sensory darkroom register into a spare, restrained one.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist A (font-size scale shift): heading sizes 600-1000 scaled down x0.92 for a refined, tighter Attio-grade type scale; body sizes unchanged; no color changes.
